_comment: How a spoken drill sounds. Every field is optional; delete this _comment freely.
input    the microphone for `pnpm mock:voice` — an ffmpeg avfoundation index, e.g. ':3'.
output   the speaker, shared by the terminal and browser paths — a `say -a '?'` id, e.g. '75'.
webInput the browser's microphone — a MediaDeviceInfo.deviceId, a different id space from `input`.
voice    a `say` voice by name, e.g. 'Ava (Premium)'. Unset means the macOS system voice.
rate     words per minute for `say -r`. Unset means the voice's own default (~175-200).
Run `pnpm voice:devices` for the device ids and `pnpm voice:voices` for the voices.
The voice tier is what decides whether this sounds like a person: macOS ships only
pre-neural legacy voices, so download an Enhanced or Premium one first —
System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content > System Voice > Manage Voices.
